# Tetris

> Classic Tetris in the browser, with neon visual effects as its twist. Plain HTML, CSS and
> JavaScript ES modules: no dependencies, no build step. English and Persian pages. Made by
> Babak Bandpey at Cocode (https://cocode.dk). Licensed Apache-2.0.

Game rules live in `src/core/` and effect state in `src/fx/`, both pure and tested with
`node --test`; `src/ui/` draws to canvas and handles input.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/cocodedk/tetris/blob/main/README.md): what it is, controls, running locally, testing, layout
- [Play (English)](https://cocodedk.github.io/tetris/): the live site
- [Play (Persian)](https://cocodedk.github.io/tetris/fa/): the Persian page

- [Product brief](https://github.com/cocodedk/tetris/blob/main/spec/brief.md): what the game is meant to be
- [Feature specs](https://github.com/cocodedk/tetris/tree/main/specs): one file per feature, in build order
